item.title: Quick Sight Decision View Design
item.description:
Amazon Quick Sight Visual Design FinOps

Product intent

CUDOS provides broad AWS cost intelligence. The custom Quick Sight analysis narrows that model to one recurring decision rather than duplicating the entire dashboard.

The reference decision view answers:

What did the selected scope cost?
How is that cost changing daily?
Which service and account filters explain the view?
When was the data last refreshed?

item.title: Presentation Logic & Calculated-Field Boundary
item.description:
Amazon Quick Sight Calculated Fields Semantic Governance

Boundary decision

Quick Sight calculated fields are appropriate for local presentation logic. They are not the correct location for shared definitions of amortized cost, chargeback, allocation, or commitment treatment because those definitions would be hidden inside one analysis.

Reusable financial meaning
→ Athena view or governed semantic layer

Local visual classification
→ Quick Sight calculated field
